text: Main samajh sakta hoon ki aapko yeh laptop bag kitna zaroori chahiye aur itni der delay hone se kitni pareshani hui hogi. Kyunki yeh order 3 weeks se transit mein stuck hai, maine aapki yeh request human support executive ko transfer kar di hai. Woh jald hi aapse sampark karke iska solution ya refund process karenge. Aapka dhairya rakhne ke liye shukriya.
